scripts.generate:api: uv run --directory ../backend python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from app.core.config import Settings; from app.main import create_app; from pydantic import PostgresDsn; Path('../frontend/openapi.json').write_text(json.dumps(create_app(Settings(_env_file=None, database_url=PostgresDsn('postgresql+asyncpg://unused@127.0.0.1/unused'))).openapi()), encoding='utf-8')" && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts && prettier --write src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.check:api: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- src/api/schema.d.ts
